'''Tarnux's blade''' was a [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]] that belonged to [[Tarnux]],<ref name="Cartel Market" /> a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who lived during the [[Third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Onslaught" />
